page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs, which correspond to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a compute-focused 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or a GPU, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.c7se.4xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory tests. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1853.98 and a multi-core score of 15550.89. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 857.97 GB/sec and an uncached large block write bandwidth of 57.38 GB/sec. In language model inference tests using a small 135M model, the instance demonstrates strong text generation performance at 266.95 tokens/sec, while prompt processing for the same model averages 1286.58 tokens/sec.

Given its compute-heavy resource allocation and lack of bundled local storage, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring dedicated CPU cycles without massive memory footprints. The inclusion of AVX-512 instruction sets and cryptography acceleration makes it suitable for compute-intensive tasks. Recommended workloads include software compilation, web serving, text processing, and small-scale machine learning inference.
